text: DSH Editor (CLI)（DSH 插件，TUI 客户端）：在 DSH 终端中浏览、查看和编辑本地文件。它通过 acryl-cli 的 tuiCommands 扩展点注册 /files 命令，并在居中的弹出面板内直接操作文件。主要功能包括按目录浏览、按名称筛选、滚动查看文本文件，以及编辑并保存文件。适合希望在终端会话中快速检查或修改本地项目文件的用户。使用需要 acryl-cli 的 tuiCommands 扩展点和 Node.js 20 或更新版本；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Editor (CLI) adds a /files popup to acryl-cli for browsing, filtering, viewing, and editing local files. It shows text with line numbers and saves edits with Ctrl+S. Requires acryl-cli tuiCommands and Node.js 20+; no API key or external service.
想在终端里直接浏览项目目录和文件。
有没有办法按文件名筛选当前目录的内容？
我想在 DSH 的 TUI 中打开文本文件查看。
让 DSH 能从终端直接修改并保存本地文件。
I want to browse and edit local project files without leaving my terminal session.
Can I filter a folder's entries by name and preview a text file in my DSH TUI?
DSH Editor (CLI) 的功能「目录浏览」：通过 /files 打开从用户主目录开始的文件列表，目录排在文件之前；可进入子目录并返回上级。
DSH Editor (CLI) 的功能「名称筛选」：在目录浏览时按 / 或输入字符启动筛选，列表会按名称匹配并优先显示前缀匹配项。
DSH Editor (CLI) 的功能「文件查看」：选中文件可打开带行号的可滚动文本视图；无法读取、过大或含二进制内容的文件会显示错误而不作为文本呈现。
DSH Editor (CLI) 的功能「就地编辑」：在文件查看模式按 e 进入编辑，可移动光标、插入和删除字符、拆分行，再按 Ctrl+S 保存回原文件。
DSH Editor (CLI) 使用前须知：浏览和编辑直接读取、写入本机文件；编辑状态按 Escape 会丢弃尚未保存的改动。
如何在 TUI 里快速返回刚才浏览的文件夹？
I need a small popup file browser that keeps my terminal chat visible.

acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-cli README · DSH Editor (CLI)：A native `/files` command for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)'s
terminal surface (`acryl-cli`) - browse, view, and edit files without
leaving the TUI.

acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-cli README · DSH Editor (CLI)：This is the TUI-native sibling of
[`acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-web`](https://github.com/acryldev/acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-web),
built for `acryl-cli`'s own presentation-slot extension point
(`tuiCommands`, spec 034 T009) rather than a browser client bundle. There is
no Host/Client split here: the CLI and its Cordis Loader tree share one
process, so this plugin's own `apply(ctx)` both registers the `/files`
command and reads/writes files directly - no wire protocol to design.

acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-cli README · Features (v2)：- **File tree** - browse from your home directory, directories-first
  sorting, `..` to go up. Vim-style `h`/`j`/`k`/`l` work alongside arrows.
- **Filter** - `/` starts an incremental, case-insensitive name filter over
  the current directory's listing.
- **File viewer** - scrollable, line-numbered.
- **Editor** - press `e` while viewing a file to edit it in place: cursor
  movement, character insert/delete, newline splitting, and `ctrl+s` to
  save. Saves go through a same-directory temp-file-then-rename, so a
  mid-write failure never leaves a half-written file on disk.
- **Back navigation** - `Escape` (or `←`/`h`) steps back one directory level
  at a time, restoring your selection to wherever you drilled in from,
  before finally closing the overlay once you're back at the start.
  `Escape` also steps back out of search, view, and edit modes the same way.

acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-cli README · Features (v2)：Deliberately still not built: cross-file/recursive search, git diff,
Markdown rendering, syntax highlighting. Syntax highlighting in particular
was evaluated and skipped deliberately - see the top-of-file comment in
`lib/index.js` for why (it needs a different rendering model than this
plugin's plain pi-tui `Component` contract provides).

acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-cli README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-cli
```

(Each profile is its own single-package pnpm workspace, which currently
needs `-w` to satisfy pnpm's own workspace-root safety check:
`dsh plugin --profile <name> add acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-cli -w`.)

After installing, restart `acryl tui`. Type `/files` at the prompt.

acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-cli README · Requirements：- Node.js `>= 20`
- `acryl-cli` with `tuiCommands` (spec 034 T009 or later) - the extension
  point this plugin registers against. Installing this on a surface without
  it (Web, Desktop) leaves the plugin's row simply inactive, not crashed:
  `tuiCommands` is a hard `inject` requirement, so the Fiber just never
  activates there.

acryl-dsh-editor-plugin-cli README · Architecture：A DSH TUI plugin declares itself via the npm package's `dsh` field
(`dsh.bundle.patch` -> `cordis.patch.yml`, which inserts the row) - the same
convention every DSH plugin uses. Unlike a Web plugin, there is no
`dsh.client` field: `lib/index.js` is a standard Cordis Host plugin whose
`apply(ctx)` calls `ctx.tuiCommands.register({command, description, open})`,
where `open({tui, close})` returns a real `pi-tui` `Component` built and
owned entirely by this package.
